images.caption: Figure 1:Correct and confident CoTs can still conceal fragile reasoning.Left: Even among the top-5% teacher-confident CoTs,18.1%fall within the global top-10% uncertainty tail.Mid: Likewise,30.5%of correct CoTs fall within the same uncertainty tail.Right: Motivated by this, we propose an uncertainty-guided progressive contraction framework. By progressively narrowing supervision from uncertainty-informative teacher reasoning to learner-relevant trajectories, we achieve competitive reasoning performance with 18.7×\timesfewer post-training steps.
